subject: social-studies
text: Hoo, hello, curator! Big news. Six crates just came in the back door of our North America and Caribbean Gallery. Inside are things the land gives us, like wood, wheat, water, fish, copper, and oil. Each crate has a tag that says where it came from. But a tag doesn't tell the whole story. Your job today is to find out how people use each one. And be honest about something curators sometimes leave out: not everything the land gives us lasts forever.
